criteria.requirement: Implement statemachine.runner.EventCall, EventResult, normalize_call and MachineRunner(machine) with dispatch(call,*,index=0,errors="raise") and run(calls,*,errors="raise"). Invoke actual send with detached positional/keyword callback arguments; reject empty calls and delay/send_id/internal controls in immediate batches. Reuse completed snapshots before/after actual execution, retain real callback result, collect only TransitionNotAllowed as error records and continue when requested. Programming/callback/source exceptions propagate. Stay lazy and sequential, preserve original native transition semantics and do not claim rollback of external callback side effects; async uses separate runner.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
